mapper.insert: INSERT INTO membership_order ( id, login_identity_id, membership_tier, pay_amount_yuan, pay_type, status, idempotency_key, provider_trade_no, payment_started_at, expires_at, closing_deadline_at, paid_at, state_version, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT #{id,jdbcType=BINARY}, #{loginIdentityId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{membershipTier,jdbcType=SMALLINT,typeHandler=com.example.temperate.mapper.typehandler.MembershipTierTypeHandler}, #{payAmountYuan,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{payType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status,jdbcType=SMALLINT,typeHandler=com.example.temperate.mapper.typehandler.MembershipOrderStatusTypeHandler}, #{idempotencyKey, javaType=java.util.UUID, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.example.temperate.mapper.typehandler.PostgreSqlUuidTypeHandler}, #{providerTradeNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{paymentStartedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{closingDeadlineAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{paidAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{stateVersion,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{updatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} FROM userloginidentity WHERE id = #{loginIdentityId,jdbcType=BIGINT} ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM membership_order WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey, javaType=java.util.UUID, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.example.temperate.mapper.typehandler.PostgreSqlUuidTypeHandler}

WITH requested AS ( SELECT DECODE(requested_value, 'hex') AS order_id, requested_ordinal FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CAST(#{idsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB) ) WITH ORDINALITY AS requested(requested_value, requested_ordinal) ) SELECT membership_order.id, membership_order.login_identity_id, membership_order.membership_tier, membership_order.pay_amount_yuan, membership_order.pay_type, membership_order.status, membership_order.idempotency_key, membership_order.provider_trade_no, membership_order.payment_started_at, membership_order.expires_at, membership_order.closing_deadline_at, membership_order.paid_at, membership_order.state_version, membership_order.created_at, membership_order.updated_at FROM requested JOIN membership_order ON membership_order.id = requested.order_id ORDER BY requested.requested_ordinal
mapper.update: WITH raw_snapshots AS ( SELECT DECODE(raw."idHex", 'hex') AS order_id, raw.status, raw."providerTradeNo" AS provider_trade_no, raw."paymentStartedAt" AS payment_started_at, raw."closingDeadlineAt" AS closing_deadline_at, raw."paidAt" AS paid_at, raw."stateVersion" AS state_version, raw."updatedAt" AS updated_at FROM jsonb_to_recordset( CAST(#{snapshotsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB) ) AS raw( "idHex" TEXT, status SMALLINT, "providerTradeNo" TEXT, "paymentStartedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ, "closingDeadlineAt" TIMESTAMPTZ, "paidAt" TIMESTAMPTZ, "stateVersion" BIGINT, "updatedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ ) ), snapshots AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (order_id) order_id, status, provider_trade_no, payment_started_at, closing_deadline_at, paid_at, state_version, updated_at FROM raw_snapshots ORDER BY order_id, state_version DESC ) UPDATE membership_order SET status = snapshots.status, provider_trade_no = COALESCE( snapshots.provider_trade_no, membership_order.provider_trade_no), payment_started_at = COALESCE( snapshots.payment_started_at, membership_order.payment_started_at), closing_deadline_at = snapshots.closing_deadline_at, paid_at = COALESCE(snapshots.paid_at, membership_order.paid_at), state_version = snapshots.state_version, updated_at = snapshots.updated_at FROM snapshots WHERE membership_order.id = snapshots.order_id AND membership_order.state_version < snapshots.state_version
